*   **Net Profit Margin:**  The Net Profit Margin for 2012 Q1 is 12.099 / 94.383 = 12.8%, compared to 9.742 / 72.802 = 13.4% for 2011 Q1. The decrease suggests increasing costs are impacting profitability.
